description: This file defines the Office365CalendarSubscriptionAdapter class, which implements calendar subscription management using Microsoft Graph API, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, validating requests, and fetching calendar events.

classes.name: Office365CalendarSubscriptionAdapter
classes.description: Implements calendar subscription management via Microsoft Graph API, including methods for validation, subscription, unsubscription, and event fetching.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with optional configuration, setting default values for base URL, webhook token, webhook URL, and subscription TTL.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates incoming requests for handshake or notification authenticity based on validation token and client state.

methods.name: extractChannelId
methods.description: Extracts subscription ID from webhook request body or headers.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new calendar subscription via Microsoft Graph API, returning subscription details.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Deletes an existing calendar subscription based on the selected calendar's resource ID.

methods.name: fetchEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events and delta links from Microsoft Graph API, returning structured event data.

methods.name: parseEvents
methods.description: Converts raw Microsoft Graph event data into internal event item format.

methods.name: getGraphClient
methods.description: Retrieves an access token for Microsoft Graph API from credentials.

methods.name: stripBase
methods.description: Removes base URL from a full URL to produce a relative path.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs HTTP requests to Microsoft Graph API with proper headers and error handling.
